hbs.title: Storage Capacity for Foodgrains and Utilisation under FCI

meta.coverage: Storage Capacity for Foodgrains and Utilisation under FCI: RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States, Table 97
meta.note: DBIE report 1645, data provider "Query 1". Values exactly as DBIE serves them; each series carries its unit (scripts/lib/products/states.mjs HBS_UNITS, read from the table's unit column and divisor); DBIE's unit column says: Lakh Metric Tonnes. Periods: as on the date served. Dimensions: none; measures: storage capacity, capacity in use, utilisation. Jammu & Kashmir to 2018-19 (with Ladakh) and from 2019-20 (the UT) are separate series; 2019-20 straddles the change of 31 October 2019.
